common_stage1.audience: Senior C++ engineers, performance owners, and the production change reviewer
common_stage1.communication_intent: Explain the arena lifecycle and measured trade-off, account for the staging failure, and obtain a decision on the guarded 10% rollout.
common_stage1.audience_outcome: The audience can trace allocation ownership through the batch, identify the failure mode, interpret the benchmark limits, and accept or reject the rollout conditions.
common_stage1.core_message: Per-thread batch arenas cut allocation activity and p99 latency in Atlas, but the memory increase and lifetime failure require a staged rollout with explicit rollback guards.
common_stage1.delivery_context: Presenter-led 18-minute technical review with the deck retained as an implementation record.
common_stage1.artifact_afterlife: Architecture review record and rollout checklist.
common_stage1.content_divergence: Reorganize for mechanism clarity, but preserve all values, lifecycle rules, scope exclusions, incident details, limitations, and rollout gates.

mode.behavior: Problem to lifecycle mechanism to evidence to failure mode to guarded decision.

visual_style.behavior: Technical editorial system with native diagrams, compact evidence tables, dark navy background, cyan emphasis, and no decorative dashboard chrome.

generated_image_rendering.behavior: Not used; native geometry carries the mechanism.
